name: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd
title: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 539997 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management guides FY27 revenue INR650-700 crore and PAT INR100 crore, but supply side is expanding: FY27-28 capex of ~INR180-190 crore (oncology, hormones, biosimilars, BE) with a working-capital stretch from Middle East receivables.

utilisation.quote: the capacity utilization came down from, I mean, from 35% to 40% to 65%.

capex.quote: FY27, we would do roughly around INR90 crores and another INR90 crores to INR100 crores in FY28.

triggers.label: FY27-28 capex ~INR180-190 crore
triggers.quote: FY27, we would do roughly around INR90 crores and another INR90 crores to INR100 crores in FY28.

triggers.label: Debtors up INR130 crore; CFO INR16 crore
triggers.quote: our debt receivables have increased like by INR130 crores and our cash flow from operation is only INR16 crores positive

triggers.label: Cash conversion cycle 208 → 170 days
triggers.quote: we improved our cash conversion cycle from 208 days to 170 days

triggers.label: FY27 INR650 crore, possibly INR700 crore
triggers.quote: this number could increase considering if we get more registrations

triggers.label: Gross margin 49% → 52-53% guided
triggers.quote: Gross profit should be 52% to 53% and the cost should be 47% to 48%.

red_flags.label: Receivables up INR130 crore vs CFO INR16 crore
red_flags.quote: our debt receivables have increased like by INR130 crores and our cash flow from operation is only INR16 crores positive

red_flags.label: Alteplase dropped and replaced by Pembrolizumab
red_flags.quote: So, Alteplase we had to drop, sir, considering the number of patients who are not available in India.

red_flags.label: Gross margin 44.8% in Q4 vs 49% FY
red_flags.quote: I think it was somewhere around 44.8%.

red_flags.label: Capex funded by working capital and bank limits
red_flags.quote: was very much financed with the existing working capital and the bank loans whatever we were returning to the banks, we were re-utilizing.
